headline: Fronts Shatter Across Linn of Mercy, Weathered Expanse, and Marban Hollow
war_summary: Since the morning dispatch, dramatic reversals have remade several central and northern battlegrounds. Linn of Mercy erupted into violent contest, where Warden forces seized ground to establish three garrisons against seven Colonial redoubts and one ruined parcel, logging ten base transactions and over a thousand casualties within two hours. Across the Weathered Expanse, Colonials executed a sweeping counterstroke, expanding their foothold from two bases to five while reducing Warden control to a single stronghold alongside three neutral wastelands. Marban Hollow suddenly flared with eleven base transfers centered upon Checkpoint Bua, fracturing the sector into four Warden bastions, three Colonial strongpoints, and one vacant ruin. Along the Nevish Line, strategic exchanges resumed with six shifts amid heavy losses exceeding fifteen hundred men. Mooring County recorded three further clashes at The Wind Hills, keeping Colonials restricted to one enclave, whereas Callahan's Passage settled under unbroken Warden command after Crumbling Post was secured, though casualty rolls there remain substantial.
